plan.title: Repeat order requires old PO reference

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed RFQ.
Allocate the available line item to the named vendor before creating the proposal.
Create and open the award proposal form.

args.label: Repeat Order / Old PO ref.If yes (Mention the PO number in running pages)

steps.note: Mark the proposal as a repeat order so the old PO reference becomes required.
Leave the required old PO reference field empty.
Attempt to submit the proposal with the required reference missing.
Assert submission is refused with an error associated with the empty old PO reference field.
